name: Improved Familiar
category: Drop Dead Studios – Advanced Rogue Talents
body:
Prerequisites: Advanced Rogue Talents, Familiar, Major Magic, Minor Magic.

Benefit: The rogue gains the Improved Familiar feat, treating her rogue level -4 as her caster level when meeting the prerequisites for the improved familiars.
